description: GET /instruments (§4.1, §3.11 item 11, DEC-2136): the instruments a version may pin in this workspace, from the fold the create's instrument check reads (versions.rs `instruments`): every ConfigSnapshotRegistered of kind instrument_snapshot in stream order, the latest per stored instrument_id. Only the pinnable are listed: an id that is not an asset id, a symbol outside 1 to 32 characters, or another asset class is omitted. Sorted by symbol, then instrument_id. as_of names the control stream. Any registration whose stored snapshot cannot be read, superseded or not, makes the whole read journal_unavailable, never a shorter list.

symbol.description: The snapshot's symbol, which a pinned instrument must name with its id (the mandate schema's instrument_ref symbol).

snapshot.description: The registration's content_hash: the instrument snapshot the checks read.
